claim: How can I connect Google Classroom to Notion? : r/Notion - Reddit
summary: It's definitely possible, both Google Classroom and Notion now have APIs where information can be extracted from. Unfortunately, you'll have to wait for someone who has enough vested interest in both Google Classroom and Notion, as well as the skills, and is willing to put the time in to make this work. If you're really interested, I encourage you to play around with the APIs yourself if you can!
